_about: The critical journeys the beta proves (owner, 1 Nov 2026), each with the steps that prove it, and the safety or data steps kept though no journey owns them. tier 1 = runs after every merge and blocks the beta (the owner's test: "it blocks the user's flow"); tier 2 = an integration test only, never an e2e step (owner, 1 Nov 2026: "tier2 should not be part by beta", "everything that's tier 2 should be dropped/converted to integrations", "Only tier 1 … should stay e2e"). The kept steps are tier 1. A tier 1 step is {suite, step}; a tier 2 step is {integration: <desktop/integration path>, test: <exact test name>}. Safety and data marks live in code, never here. parts: literals of a name the code builds.

journeys.name: The app starts and draws every screen (smoke)

steps.step: every Settings section renders

journeys.name: Set up the app: key, CV, strategy, first search

steps.step: the app starts on the welcome screen
a valid API key is accepted and saved
a CV is chosen and read
the strategy is built from the CV and shows roles to search for
saving the strategy reaches the finish action
finishing the setup without Notion opens the Jobs list, with the strategy kept on this Mac
Jobs opens on the Find jobs card; pressing it starts the first search
a new install keeps its data on this Mac: the store is set once at first start

journeys.name: Find jobs: a check reads feeds, drops wrong roles, scores

steps.step: a jobs check reads the fixture feeds, drops the wrong roles and scores the matching jobs
every scored job in the Jobs list is its Job Matches record, with the same score, and none is missing

journeys.name: LinkedIn (opt-in): reads with your session, leaks nothing, stops at checks

steps.step: LinkedIn answers 429: one search is opened, LinkedIn is left alone for a day and the next press asks it for nothing
LinkedIn on: a press reads the guest list in the app's hidden browser with the copied session, keeps the jobs, and leaves no LinkedIn cookie in that browser
LinkedIn sends the read to its sign-in page: one search is opened, the read stops and says to sign in again
LinkedIn shows a check: one search is opened, the read stops, the check is not answered
Stop in the middle of a LinkedIn read closes its tab and takes the session out of the browser
the copied session is in no log, run or store file of the app, only in the run's secrets file
with the switch off a press asks LinkedIn for nothing and the session is gone from the secrets file

journeys.name: Apply: the extension fills the form, you submit

steps.step: a Greenhouse-like form: every kit answer and your details are filled, the CV is attached, the legal box is left, Submit untouched
the person submits a form: the page after Submit is read, the job becomes Applied, its session leaves the list
through all of it: Submit was never clicked or submitted, and no host but the fixture job sites was contacted
through all of it: Submit was never clicked or submitted, and no host but the fixture job sites was contacted

journeys.name: Full automation: asks once, submits once, Stop holds

steps.step: Full automation presses Submit once on its own, and a Stop in the wait presses nothing
Full automation hands a bot check to the person: the card says so with Submit off, and nothing is pressed or sent
Full automation presses each queued job once, one at a time, in queue order, and a Stop on a queued job skips only that one
Full automation asks once in Settings → Apply: Not now keeps the old mode and saves no confirmation, Turn on Full automation saves it
Full automation saved without its confirmation: the app refuses to start, and nothing is filled or sent
the app quits in Full automation's wait: after it starts again the job is handed to you, and nothing is pressed when the wait runs out
Stop on the card in Full automation: the wait says when it will submit, Stop hands it to you, and nothing is posted past the due time

journeys.name: Apply in the hidden browser: fills, you submit, queue in order

steps.step: The hidden browser fills a form, the person's Submit in the live view posts it once and the job becomes Applied

journeys.name: Tailor a CV for a job

steps.test: Tailor CV on a job: that job's form gets the tailored PDF under its own name, every other form the general CV
Tailor on the session page restarts only that job's open form, and it is handed the tailored CV under its own name
asked for 2, it takes the two best open jobs without a CV in fit order and leaves the third alone; asked again, it takes the third; with every CV made there is nothing to do
a form whose app hands it a tailored CV gets that file attached, under its own name, and not the general CV

journeys.name: Track an application through its stages

steps.step: the board shows the store's applications in their stage columns
moving a card to Interviewing writes the stage and its event to the store, and it stays after a reload

journeys.name: Your data stays yours: export, backup, import, move

steps.step: Your data: export with keys, reset, then import from the setup brings this computer back as it was
Automatic backup: the backup file, imported after a reset, brings this computer back as it was
the export, imported into a fresh install, shows the same on every screen (still this Mac's store)
the imported install moves into an empty Notion: its Profile and every record arrive once

journeys.name: A run that fails ends in words, never Running for ever

steps.step: the AI says the key is invalid (401): the run ends as Failed or with warnings, in words, with nothing left Running
parts: the AI says the key is invalid (401)
: the run ends as Failed or with warnings, in words, with nothing left Running

steps.step: quitting the app in the middle of a run: it is not shown Running for ever, and the app says what became of it

journeys.name: Updates: only approved builds are offered

steps.step: a newer stable release is offered to everyone, in the menu foot
an approved beta is offered only on the beta channel
a pre-release the gate has not approved is never offered, even on the beta channel

journeys.name: Strategy: a role or place change is used by the next check

steps.step: the next check keeps the posting that matches the new role and place, and still drops the other
a role changed in the app is used by the next check, and a removed role stops matching
an edit made directly on the Notion page is used by the next check, and a removed role stops matching

journeys.name: Profile: the CV is read, its problems are found

steps.step: the CV check reads real PDFs: a plain CV passes, each known problem is found, a picture of a CV fails

journeys.name: What we learned: sign-up answers stay out, a menu choice is remembered

steps.test: a sign-up page before the form: the account step is kept apart from the application form
the menu's choice is picked once, armed, remembered for the site and handed to the next form
a menu whose choices are not the answer's words: the form reports the menu with its choices, and the choice the app picks is put in it
a menu choice the app remembers for the site is on the next form there at once, with nothing reported to ask about

journeys.name: Gmail check: reads the inbox and ends in words

steps.test: the Gmail check reads the inbox through Google and ends in words, with nothing left Running
every Settings section the page lists opens and has no layout problems

journeys.name: Interviews: an interview is linked to a job and unlinked again

steps.test: an interview can be linked to a job and unlinked again, and the store follows
the one-time setup banner shows its step and percent, then goes away when transcribing starts

journeys.name: Focus: a job dismissed from In process stays gone

steps.test: Dismiss a job in process (#2758): the job reads as written in a read made inside Notion's listing lag, in the saved list, and after the lag ends
parts: : the job reads as written in a read made inside Notion's listing lag, in the saved list, and after the lag ends

kept.step: a Workday-shaped form: answers fill fields known only by opaque ids and aria labels, the list-button question is left for you by name, Submit untouched
a multi-step form: step 1 is filled, step 2 only once you reach it, the consent is left to you, Submit untouched
Background automation hands a bot check to the person: the card says so with Submit off, and nothing is sent
Background automation fills several queued jobs one at a time, in queue order, and a Stop on a queued job skips only that one
a real posting, watched live: the page kinds, stages and fills as they happen (nothing is pressed on the page)
the app quits while Background automation holds a filled form: after it starts again the job is handed to you, and nothing is posted
a silent Chrome in Full automation: a queued hidden-browser job says why it waits when the app's link is off, and never talks of the person's Chrome; nothing is submitted
Stop on the card in Background automation: while the form is filling, Stop hands it to you and nothing is posted
the triage bar moves per real read and Cancel during a held read stops before the next job, closes its page, and fills or sends nothing
checking jobs before the form read exists reads nothing: every chip says "Not checked", no session starts, nothing is filled or sent
a form drawn after a spinner: its submit is never pressed as Apply, and it is filled once its fields come
the crawl's source list now holds the starter employers and the two new boards, and nothing else
a second run writes nothing twice
a Save that Notion refuses is never shown as saved: the person is told in words, and Notion and the list still agree
Automatic backup: Back up now writes a backup with no keys in its folder, and View backups opens it
Automatic backup: a due backup runs once at start and once on the weekly tick
an app on this Mac's store holds real-shaped data on every screen
Export data writes this Mac's data to one file
Notion connects with a Profile of its own; this Mac keeps its data until the move
a move killed halfway changes nothing, and the next one goes on with nothing twice
after the move the store is Notion, the Profile Notion had is kept, and this Mac's files are in the archive
Jobs, Focus, Interviews and Recent activity show the same items from Notion
